ṭīkiyati: [Ṭīka+ya+te] (kamma,kri) CL=8 It should be known. Ṭīkā- Look.
ṭīkā: [Ṭika=ṭīka+a+ā] (thī) CL=8 Ṭikiyati jāniyati saṃvaṇṇanāya attho etāyāti ṭīkā. Nīti,dhā.17. Ṭīkiyati jāniyati aṭṭhakathāyattho etāyāti ṭīkā. Dhātvattha.] Ṭīkā Book, book expressed the meaning of Aṭṭhakathā (commentaties on Buddhist Pali texts).
ṭīkācariya: [Ṭīkākāra+ācariya] (pu) CL=8 Kāra-pudakiukhye.] scribed for  ṭīkā thesis,  ṭīkā scribe.
ṭīkākāra: [Ṭīkā+kara+ṇa] (pu) CL=8 who is Author of the Book of  Ṭīkā, Ṭīkā author.
ṭīkākāramata: [Ṭīkākāra+mata] (na) CL=8 The will of the scribe  (the will of the original scribe).
ṭīkākārācariya: [Ṭīkākāra+ācariya] (pu) CL=8 The scribe Ṭīkā, Ṭīkā teacher.
ṭīkānaya: [Ṭīkā+naya] (pu) CL=8 method which is come from Ṭīkā thesis, Ṭīkā way.
ṭīkāniṭṭhānakālaparicchedadassana: [Ṭīkā+niṭṭhāna+kāla+pariccheda+dassana] (na) CL=8 sadda that shows time of completion of Ṭīkā thesis.
